commandAliases.name: creative
commandAliases.description: Drive the native image/audio/video/vector engines from the operator side

binaryPath.description: Path to the image engine library (.dll/.so/.dylib) or a directory containing it. Defaults to the bundled binaries dir.
Path to the audio engine library (.dll/.so/.dylib) or a directory containing it.
Path to the video engine library (.dll/.so/.dylib) or a directory containing it.
Path to the vector engine library (.dll/.so/.dylib) or a directory containing it.

codec.description: Media codec configuration (ffmpeg is used only to decode/encode audio and video; the operations run in-process on the C++ engines).

ffmpegPath.description: ffmpeg binary path, or a directory containing ffmpeg/ffprobe (e.g. C:/ffmpeg/bin). Defaults to ffmpeg on PATH.

ffprobePath.description: ffprobe binary path. Defaults alongside ffmpeg.

mediaUnderstanding.description: Keyframe video understanding (media-understanding provider id 'creative-engines'). The vision model is normally taken from tools.media.video.models[].model; these keys are overrides.

enabled.description: Set false to not register describeVideo at all. Default true.

visionModel.description: Vision model ref used to describe keyframes, e.g. 'ollama/qwen2.5vl:7b'. Overrides tools.media.* model resolution.

visionProvider.description: Provider used when visionModel has no 'provider/' prefix. Default 'ollama'.

maxFrames.description: Maximum keyframes extracted and described per video. Default 6, hard cap 24. Each frame is one vision call (~2-20s).

sceneThreshold.description: ffmpeg scene-cut sensitivity 0-1 for detect_scenes. Default 0.3.

frameTimeoutMs.description: Per-frame vision timeout in ms. Always bounded by the host budget from tools.media.video.timeoutSeconds. Default 120000.

maxCharsPerFrame.description: Trim each frame description to this many characters. 0 disables trimming. Default 320.

transcribeNarration.description: Fold the clip's spoken content into the description: the video engine's extract_audio op demuxes a WAV and the HOST transcribes it with whatever is configured under tools.media.audio.models[]. Default true. With no transcriber configured the output carries one 'Narration: NOT transcribed' line and the keyframe description is unaffected.

narrationLanguage.description: Language hint passed to the host audio pipeline, e.g. 'en'. Omit to let the transcriber auto-detect.

maxCharsNarration.description: Trim the folded transcript to this many characters. 0 disables trimming. Default 4000. Note the host also trims the whole answer to tools.media.video.maxChars (default 500) — raise that to see both the transcript and every keyframe.
